answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker must acquire and stake N distinct devices, then invest real labor before any payout, while a single orchard of colluding identities loses all stake once one is flagged and slashed. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-backed key as its identity anchor, and reputation accrues only through verified work in a shared garden of tasks. That makes each fake identity costlier than the rewards it could ever harvest. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
